description: This file defines the 'Marketing' model class for the OpenCart admin extension, responsible for retrieving marketing-related data from the database, including campaign details and total counts.

classes.name: Marketing
classes.description: A model class extending OpenCart's base engine model, providing methods to fetch marketing campaign data and statistics.

methods.name: getMarketing
methods.description: Retrieves a list of marketing campaigns with their details and associated order counts, filtered and paginated based on input parameters.

methods.name: getTotalMarketing
methods.description: Returns the total number of marketing campaigns in the database, useful for pagination.
